project.name: Decision Engine :: API Language Bindings
project.description:
Generated clients/stubs for decision-engine-api-specifications' canonical interface definitions - mirrors agent-os-api-language-bindings' own {java,python,typescript} split in forwardmeasure-agent-os exactly. Each language module unpacks decision-engine-api- specifications' packaged jar (maven-dependency-plugin:unpack) and generates from that unpacked copy - it never reads or copies the .proto source files directly. There is exactly one copy of every interface-definition source file in this repository, in decision-engine-api-specifications; nowhere else.
Each language is further split by PROTOCOL (grpc/ today; a thrift/ sibling can be added later under each language without restructuring anything here) - protocol is this repository's equivalent of the "per-service" split agent-os-api-language-bindings uses, since this repository exposes one logical service through potentially more than one wire protocol rather than multiple distinct services through one protocol.
